summary: FindLocationForWorksheet is a web page and backend code module that provides a user interface for searching, selecting, and creating worksheet entries for locations (destinations) within the HSPnet system. It enables users to search using multiple filters (agency, governing organization, site type, service, region, province, discipline, keyword) and then select locations to associate with a worksheet. Advanced controls, dynamic dropdowns, error/warning panels, and reporting functionality are included.
purpose: To enable users to find, filter, and select destinations for a worksheet within HSPnet, and to create worksheet entries for each selected destination based on configurable criteria such as group size, worksheet type, and template usage.

workflows.name: Search and Select Locations for Worksheet
steps: Page loads, reads WorksheetID and CFOFlag from query string.
GetLookupData populates dropdowns for filters using agency, site type, service, governing org, region, province, discipline, etc.
User enters keyword and selects filter criteria.
User clicks 'Search' (cmdSearch_Click): runs search via HSPnet.DataLayer.Locations, displays results in gridData.
If too many rows found, shows warning/caption.
User can use Select All / Select None buttons to bulk select locations.
User may create worksheet entries: for each selected row, site/service/destination IDs are gathered; group size is checked/validated.
Location.CreateWorksheetEntries is called with user/session data and selected IDs.
ASSD cache is cleared to ensure up-to-date worksheet edit screen.

workflows.name: Print Results
steps: Results shown in lblReportHTML and pnlReportHTML.

workflows.name: Clear Filters
steps: All filter controls and grid are reset.

business_rules: Worksheet creation is only possible if both WorksheetID and CFOFlag are provided.
Group size must be a valid integer if GWSFlag is set; defaults to 1 otherwise.
If too many results, display warning and help link.
Dropdowns always contain an 'All' option inserted as first item.
validations: ValidationSummary1 and ValidationSummary2 collect validation errors.
CompareValidator4 ensures txtGroupSize is an integer.
RequiredFieldValidator2 ensures txtGroupSize is entered when required.
calculations: Comma-delimited lists of selected SiteID, ServiceID, DestinationID for worksheet creation.
conditions: cmdCreate is only visible if both WorksheetID and CFOFlag are not null/empty.
spnGroupSize is shown only if GWSFlag is enabled.
If page is not postback or clearPressed is true, spnMatches is hidden.
system_behavior: Dropdowns populated dynamically from lookup data.
Error and warning panels shown/hidden via script controls.
Search results and worksheet creation update UI and trigger back-end updates.
Client-side scripts register field variables and checkboxes for select-all/none.
exceptions: Too many search results (MAX_ROWS hit): warning is displayed with help link.
Invalid or missing input for worksheet creation: validation prevents action.
content_gaps: No explicit database schema for Agency, GoverningOrg, SiteType, Service, Region, Province, Discipline.
Some referenced methods (e.g., Location.CreateWorksheetEntries, HSPnet.DataLayer.Locations) implementation details not provided.
Resource strings (e.g., Resources.*, error/warning messages) not defined in content.
No user stories or detailed UI wireframes.
